titulo: Transition of respiratory bronchiole to alveolar ducts
descricao_original: This image shows another example of a respiratory bronchiole branching to forming multiple alveolar ducts. Alveolar ducts consist almost entirely of alveoli, the wall being reduced to knob-like interalveolar septa. Alveolar ducts end as alveolar sacs with alveoli clustered around a central space. 40x
creditos_identificados: Image source: The image was taken of a slide in the University of New England College of Osteopathic Medicine collection.
